t: 48H Pure Peak Grit: from hill-hater to hill-lover – Duracell Bunny on a Bike
s: December 30, 2019 - What is 48 hour Pure Peak Grit? Pure Peak Grit is a single ride which links together every known categorised climb in the Peak Distric and many ‘Top 100’ climbs surrounding it. The route is 380 miles long, and takes in over 13,000m of ascent. It includes at least 42 fearsome hills with gradients of between 10-25%. In this first edition of the event, 10 female riders attempted to complete the ride within 48 hours.
